topFindings.title: UI layout code is FAITHFUL; song-library/HUD bugs are NOT layout-math divergences
topFindings.evidence: native/CMakeLists.txt:250,261 compile the decomp's own src/system/ui/*.cpp (UIList/UILabel/UIScreen) and src/system/rndobj/Text.cpp directly. No native reimpl of text layout, wrap, width, or UIList slot math. The bugs live elsewhere (data + render backend + transforms).

topFindings.title: Dominant root cause is DATA: 360 .milo_xbox assets run through Wii-decomp engine
topFindings.evidence: main_native.cpp:360,527,715 force TheLoadMgr.mPlatform=kPlatformXBox loading orig-assets/extracted. Squished text (non-square 360 atlas, Font.h:97-124), stale-slot overlap (MusicLibrary.cpp:1094-1108), HUD score not updating (UILabel vs AppLabel class mismatch, UILabel.cpp:952) are ALL 360-vs-Wii asset-format mismatches, not renderer bugs.

topFindings.title: Render backend re-derives camera projection, discarding faithful RndCam::mWorldProjectXfm
topFindings.evidence: Rnd_Wgpu_RB3.cpp:1308-1400 calls cam->UpdateLocal() then ignores mLocalProjectXfm/mWorldProjectXfm and rebuilds from YFov+window-aspect, dropping mScreenRect, mUnknownFloat, GetAspect()/YRatio(), and mZRange (Cam.cpp:155-192). Coincidentally matches only for full-screen 16:9 (YRatio kWidescreen=0.5625). Forces per-mesh zMode=Disable text heuristic instead of faithful mZRange layering.

topFindings.title: Text detection by nameless-mesh proxy is unsound; collides with impostor crowd billboards
topFindings.evidence: isTextMeshHeur = !mesh->Name()[0] (Rnd_Wgpu_RB3.cpp:5772) mis-tags nameless impostor-crowd billboards (:6054-6060 must re-exclude) and misses NAMED score digits (:5807 isLikelyUiText broadening). Should key off material font-texture + pre_lit/use_environ (data-driven), not name substrings. Removes useAlphaAsRGB icon exclusion + num/_source/.lbl/font/label nets.

topFindings.title: Highlight-bar and scrollbar-thumb wrong position are a real transform-propagation gap
topFindings.evidence: Rnd_Wgpu_RB3.cpp:4459-4535: SetWorldXfm on a UI labelDir (UILabel.cpp:334) does not reach skinned corner-bone parent chain, so skinned UI meshes render at world origin (screen center). Two name-scoped workarounds (RB3_NO_HUB_BAR_PLACEMENT_FIX + scrollbar block). Same root cause as lane-3 crowd/drum placement.

topFindings.title: TransparentQueue is dead code for RB3; draw order is faithful submission order
topFindings.evidence: TransparentQueue.cpp/FlushTextDraws/DrawMeshImmediate are DC3's Mesh_Wgpu path; zero refs in Rnd_Wgpu_RB3.cpp. BandRnd::DrawMesh (:3837) issues DrawIndexed immediately (:6383) in traversal order = Wii painter order. The DC3 back-to-front distSq sort (wrong for co-planar 2D) is not in play. UI ordering is equivalent to Wii.

bugRootCauseHypotheses.bug: Song library layout/overlap family (stale-slot, squished text, headers-as-rows)
bugRootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: 360-ARK .milo_xbox assets differ from Wii assets the decomp expects: non-square font atlases (bad glyph aspect), slots authored visible-not-hidden (MusicLibrary::Text override never clears), widgets authored UILabel not AppLabel (cast drops text). Fix at asset layer or load Wii assets; NOT a layout-math or z-order bug.

bugRootCauseHypotheses.bug: HUD score mid-screen / star meter wrong / score not updating
bugRootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Mix of widget-class data mismatch (score.lbl authored UILabel; set_score_or_stars unhandled without the UILabel.cpp:952 fallback) and the origin-placement transform family (SetWorldXfm not reaching skinned bones).

bugRootCauseHypotheses.bug: Grey ticker quad on main hub
bugRootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Not root-caused in this lane; likely a missing/mis-bound diffuse or alpha-write masking interaction on the ticker material (render bug), per project_visual_diff_2026_07_02.md.

RENDER: font glyphs live in texture alpha (RGB==0); default shader samples RGB. Faithful mechanism is material-authored alpha-as-color-source (WiiMat GX_SRC_REG + TEV). Current name-heuristic useAlphaAsRGB + 'icon' exclusion approximate it.

refactorRecs: Re-evaluate loading Wii .milo assets instead of 360 .milo_xbox — deletes the entire DATA bug bucket at the source (squished text, stale-slot overlap, widget-class mismatch) with zero heuristics.

If 360 assets must stay, build ONE load-time asset-normalization layer (square-normalize font cell metrics, promote UILabel->AppLabel where code casts, honor author-hidden slots) instead of scattered #ifdef HX_NATIVE patches in faithful source.

Consume RndCam::mWorldProjectXfm (already computed by UpdateLocal) instead of rebuilding the projection from YFov+window-aspect; honors mScreenRect/mUnknownFloat/aspect/mZRange automatically and lets you delete the zMode=Disable text heuristic.
Replace the nameless-mesh text proxy + name-substring nets with material-driven detection (font texture + pre_lit/use_environ, which RndMat already carries).
Fold highlight-bar + scrollbar-thumb placement fixes into the lane-3 skinned-UI SetWorldXfm transform-propagation fix.
Delete the >=0.6 UI text color floor (no faithful basis; can only diverge from retail).

Add a UI-parity screenshot-diff gate on scripts/analysis/visual_diff.py against images/retail-screenshots (Wii song_select_list/album_art/diff_ratings/filter_panel + 360 menu_hub), driven headless via /api/screenshot + song-select-capture.py, using per-slot text-region SSIM + bbox-overlap (not global RMSE) to catch stale-slot overlap and squished-glyph regressions; run in the integration-worktree full-rebuild gate.
